description: Search live LADBS permit records (building, electrical, mechanical; issued or submitted), certificates of occupancy, or the legacy detailed dataset - or look up exact permits by number, address, contractor, or assessor parcel.

aduOnly.description: Keep only permits that add at least one ADU or junior ADU. Available on live feeds.
aduOnly.title: ADU permits only

appToken.description: Optional free Socrata app token to raise API rate limits. Not required.
appToken.title: Socrata app token (optional)

assessorBook.description: LA County Assessor Identification Number (AIN) book component, for mode=byAssessorParcel. All three components are required. Example: 2405.
assessorBook.title: Assessor book

businessUnit.description: How LADBS processed the permit. Express Permit is the same as No Plan Check.
businessUnit.title: Issuing business unit

communityPlanArea.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the LADBS community plan area. Example: Venice. Available on live permit feeds only, not on the CoO/legacy detailed datasets.
communityPlanArea.title: Community plan area contains

constructionType.description: Building-code construction class, published on live feeds for a minority of permits.
constructionType.title: Construction type

contractorName.description: Exact contractor business name for mode=byContractor (Certificate of Occupancy + legacy detailed datasets, including the 2013-2023 all-trades file); substring filter in search mode (Certificate of Occupancy + 2015-2023 legacy detailed datasets). These are the only sources that publish contractor names; status is refreshed from the live feed.
contractorName.title: Contractor business name

councilDistrict.description: Filter to one Los Angeles city council district (1-15). Available on live permit feeds only, not on the CoO/legacy detailed datasets.
councilDistrict.title: Council district

dataset.description: Which LADBS record family to read. 'issuedBuilding' is the current live building-permit feed and the best default. 'submittedBuilding' returns applications before issuance (useful for early leads). Electrical and mechanical datasets carry trade permits. 'certificateOfOccupancy' returns completed/occupiable buildings with contractor details. 'legacyDetailed' is the frozen 2015-2023 detailed dataset.
dataset.title: Dataset

evChargingOnly.description: Keep only permits flagged by LADBS for electric-vehicle charging. Available on live feeds.
evChargingOnly.title: EV-charging permits only

includeDetails.description: Batch-look up each live-feed permit in the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets to fill contractor, applicant, licence, occupancy, stories and residential-unit fields where LADBS publishes them. Adds a few requests per 100 permits. Detail-dataset records are always refreshed with current live status regardless of this setting.
includeDetails.title: Include contractor / occupancy details

includeInspections.description: Batch-look up the LADBS inspections dataset and add inspectionCount, first/last inspection date, and last inspection type/result. Only populated where inspections exist.
includeInspections.title: Include inspection summaries

initiatingOffice.description: Filter to a single LADBS district office. Only published in the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets; when set, the actor searches those.
initiatingOffice.title: Initiating office

issueDateFrom.description: Drop permits issued before this date. The actor automatically reads the matching era dataset (2020+, 2010-2019, pre-2010).
issueDateFrom.title: Issue date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

issueDateTo.description: Drop permits issued after this date.
issueDateTo.title: Issue date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

maxSquareFootage.description: Drop permits with a higher published square footage.
maxSquareFootage.title: Max square footage

maxStories.description: Drop permits with more stories. Only published in the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets; when set, the actor searches those.
maxStories.title: Max number of stories

maxValuation.description: Drop permits with a higher applicant-declared construction valuation.
maxValuation.title: Max valuation (USD)

minResidentialUnits.description: Drop permits with fewer residential dwelling units. Only published in the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets; when set, the actor searches those.
minResidentialUnits.title: Min residential dwelling units

minSquareFootage.description: Drop permits with a lower published square footage. Permits without a published figure are excluded when this is set.
minSquareFootage.title: Min square footage

minStories.description: Drop permits with fewer stories. Only published in the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets; when set, the actor searches those.
minStories.title: Min number of stories

minValuation.description: Drop permits with a lower applicant-declared construction valuation. The figure is declared on the application, not a contract price.
minValuation.title: Min valuation (USD)

mode.description: How to find permits. Search applies filters and returns a list; the lookup modes resolve exact numbers, an address, a contractor, or an assessor parcel.
mode.title: Mode

nearLatitude.description: Latitude of a centre point. Combine with nearLongitude (and optionally radiusMeters) to return only permits within a radius. Example: 34.0522 (downtown LA).
nearLatitude.title: Near latitude (geo-radius search)

nearLongitude.description: Longitude of the centre point. Example: -118.2437 (downtown LA).
nearLongitude.title: Near longitude (geo-radius search)

neighborhoodCouncil.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the neighbourhood council name. Example: Encino. Available on live permit feeds only, not on the CoO/legacy detailed datasets.
neighborhoodCouncil.title: Neighborhood council contains

occupancy.description: Building-code occupancy classification. Only published in the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets; when set, the actor searches those.
occupancy.title: Occupancy group

permitCategory.description: Filter by plan-check path. 'No Plan Check' means express/e-permit; 'Plan Check' means plans were reviewed.
permitCategory.title: Plan check category

permitNumbers.description: Exact PCIS permit numbers for mode=byPermitNumbers. Paste one or many, with hyphens or spaces. Example: 24016-20000-19408.
permitNumbers.title: Permit numbers

permitType.description: Filter to one LADBS permit type. Building values include Bldg-New, Bldg-Addition, Bldg-Alter/Repair, Bldg-Demolition, Grading, Swimming-Pool/Spa and Sign. Electrical and mechanical types (Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC, Fire Sprinkler, Elevator, Pressure Vessel) automatically select the matching trade dataset when dataset is left at its default.
permitType.title: Permit type

radiusMeters.description: Search radius around the centre point. Only used when both coordinates are set.
radiusMeters.title: Radius (meters)

solarOnly.description: Keep only permits flagged by LADBS as solar. Available on live feeds.
solarOnly.title: Solar permits only

sortBy.description: Order for live datasets. The stories / residential-unit options are kept for saved tasks and work on the Certificate of Occupancy and legacy detailed datasets; live feeds fall back to issue date with a status note.
sortBy.title: Sort by

status.description: Filter to one current status. The exact wording differs by dataset (issued, submitted, CoO).
status.title: Status

statusDateFrom.description: Drop permits whose latest status change is before this date.
statusDateFrom.title: Status date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

statusDateTo.description: Drop permits whose latest status change is after this date.
statusDateTo.title: Status date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

streetDirection.description: Filter to a single street direction prefix. Applied server-side on detailed datasets and to the published address on live feeds.
streetDirection.title: Street direction

streetName.description: Street name without direction or suffix. Required for mode=byAddress (exact street match); in search mode it is a substring filter on the address. Example: HARVARD.
streetName.title: Street name

streetNumber.description: Building street number for mode=byAddress. Optional: leave empty to return every permit on the street. Example: 6500.
streetNumber.title: Street number

streetSuffix.description: Filter to a single street-suffix abbreviation. Applied server-side on detailed datasets and to the published address on live feeds.
streetSuffix.title: Street suffix

submittedDateFrom.description: Drop applications submitted before this date. Select dataset=submittedBuilding (or a submitted trade dataset) to include applications before issuance.
submittedDateFrom.title: Submitted date from (YYYY-MM-DD)

submittedDateTo.description: Drop applications submitted after this date.
submittedDateTo.title: Submitted date to (YYYY-MM-DD)

useDescriptionKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the LADBS use description. Example: Accessory Dwelling Unit, Office, Retail. Available on live feeds.
useDescriptionKeyword.title: Use description contains

workDescriptionKeyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the permit's work description. Example: swimming pool.
workDescriptionKeyword.title: Work description contains

zipCodes.description: Restrict results to one or more 5-digit LA zip codes. Example: 90047.
zipCodes.title: Zip codes

title: Los Angeles Building Permits Scraper Input
